trackDescriptionDetailPage: This year, the Shared Sky track has been created for the hackathon purists and those who want to make a difference in the social issues of today’s world. In this track, we want you to research and understand an issue faced by Indigenous Australian and/or Torres Strait Islander communities then create a solution which can help to solve this problem. Contestants in this track will expected to show the ability to properly research and explain their area of focus then develop a solution that addresses this area of focus. Recommended for those who have previous experience in hackathons.
